events.continuity_hook: Closes the Mesa tournament planning thread after the flight-versus-drive and hotel choices were narrowed.
events.interaction_goal: Confirm the Friday arrival timeline, two-queen hotel setup, breakfast and parking details, venue drive time, and a practical Sunday airport cutoff; decide whether the existing return is still safe if the final match runs late.
events.scenario_brief: A few days before the Mesa volleyball weekend, the team posts court assignments, the hotel asks Tessa to guarantee a late Friday arrival, and the Sunday bracket now could run close to the evening return flight. The family is still planning to fly after school and work on Friday, but seat assignments are scattered and the return timing needs one last look.

events.continuity_hook: Returns from the family tournament weekend to the final fall recruitment stretch.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the open-jaw, Minneapolis round-trip, Chicago-area, and full-drive plans; sketch the Sunday-through-Thursday route; identify likely hotel areas; and flag winter driving, airfare, rental car, breakfast, parking, dinner, and materials-handling issues before she asks for approval.
events.scenario_brief: After the Mesa weekend, Tessa receives a draft mid-November upper Midwest recruitment route: a Monday morning counselor breakfast in St. Paul, a Monday evening fair in Minneapolis, Tuesday school visits around Eau Claire and La Crosse, a Wednesday evening transfer fair in Madison, and a Thursday late-morning counselor meeting near Milwaukee. She needs to decide whether to fly into Minneapolis and return from Milwaukee, loop back to Minneapolis, route through Chicago, or drive the whole trip with materials.

events.continuity_hook: Refines the Midwest route once host times, fair logistics, and return-flight options become clearer.
events.interaction_goal: Rank the open-jaw, Minneapolis-return, and Chicago-area options; choose the likely overnight sequence; compare St. Paul, Roseville, Madison, and Milwaukee-area hotel trade-offs; and identify which refundable rooms should be held first.
events.scenario_brief: The upper Midwest hosts adjust the route before booking: La Crosse moves earlier on Tuesday, the Madison transfer fair confirms a later evening end time, and the Milwaukee meeting stays Thursday late morning at a suburban campus. Hotels closest to the Minneapolis fair are above the nightly cap or charge for parking, while practical St. Paul and Roseville options include breakfast but add morning drive time. The Milwaukee return has one calmer afternoon connection, while looping back to Minneapolis would require a long Thursday drive.

events.continuity_hook: Moves the upper Midwest recruitment loop from comparison into reservations.
events.interaction_goal: Finalize flights, request window seats where available, reserve the rental car, choose the three hotels, confirm queen-room availability, breakfast hours, parking, restaurant access, and assemble the airfare and lodging notes for reimbursement.
events.scenario_brief: Tessa's office approves the open-jaw plan because it avoids a Thursday backtrack across Wisconsin and Minnesota. She is ready to book a Sunday afternoon Salt Lake City-to-Minneapolis flight, a Thursday afternoon Milwaukee-to-Salt Lake City return with one connection, a rental car with room for boxes, and hotels near St. Paul or Roseville, Madison, and Milwaukee or Brookfield. The remaining details are room setup, breakfast timing before early starts, parking charges, nearby dinner options, and the note explaining the higher airfare.

events.continuity_hook: Handles final timing, weather, food, and materials logistics for the booked upper Midwest trip.
events.interaction_goal: Decide whether to keep the changed return or move to a later connection, add drive buffers between Wisconsin stops, set a quick breakfast plan for the Madison morning, update the Milwaukee arrival window, and make a concise packing, receipt, and materials-security checklist.
events.scenario_brief: The week before departure, the airline moves Tessa's Milwaukee connection earlier by enough to make the transfer feel tight, and an early winter forecast could slow the Tuesday and Wednesday drives. The Madison hotel also confirms breakfast starts after she needs to leave for a morning school visit, and the Milwaukee campus sends a separate materials drop-off gate for Thursday.

events.continuity_hook: Starts a personal holiday-planning thread after the last major fall recruitment trip.
events.interaction_goal: Compare flying versus driving for the Wednesday-to-Sunday window, identify practical hotel areas near the relatives, check two-queen rooms, breakfast, parking, and nearby food, and choose a return timing that protects Monday school and work.
events.scenario_brief: After the fall recruitment loop wraps up, Tessa's spouse's family confirms Thanksgiving in San Diego. The teens can leave after an early school release on Wednesday and need to be back Sunday night, but relatives have limited sleeping space, so a nearby hotel may be needed. Airfares are rising, the holiday return window is crowded, and the family needs to decide whether all four should fly, drive, or have only part of the family go.
